The software product **Leaflet** provided at **leafletjs.com** is an open-source library created and provided by developer **Volodymyr Agafonkin** (along with an open-source community of contributors). 

* **Evidence / Provider Statement:** On the official website ([leafletjs.com](https://leafletjs.com/)), the homepage notes: *"Leaflet was originally created by Volodymyr Agafonkin, but is now developed by a big community of contributors"*, and the site and software license display the copyright notice: *"© 2010–2026 Volodymyr Agafonkin"*.
